english.title: Marker / buoy / dahn not from relevant fishing vessel did not display name / telephone - NIFCA Byelaws
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3(b) of byelaw 5 of the Northumberland Inshore Fisheries and Conservation Authority Byelaws (NIFCA) and section 163 of the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used a marker buoy / dahn in accordance with paragraph 2 of byelaw 5 of the Northumberland Inshore Fisheries and Conservation Authority Byelaws
placed the marker buoy / dahn that was not from a relevant fishing vessel and that marker buoy / dahn did not display the owner's name and telephone number

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See H101977 for the offence where the marker buoy / dahn was placed from a relevant fishing vessel.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine.

Time limits for prosecutions:
6 months.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
